# Switchremote

> Switchremote is a free job board that lists remote jobs freshers can apply for. No signup and no fees. Jobs are gathered from company career pages and remote job boards, and refreshed every 6 hours. Each listing links to the original source, where people apply.

Switchremote does not hire, does not collect applications, and does not promise that any listing is genuine. Listings stay up for 14 days.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: freshers, students and recent graduates looking for their first remote or work-from-home job, including internships, trainee, graduate and entry-level roles
- Where: focus on India, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand, plus remote jobs open to any country
- How jobs are picked: only fully remote roles from companies we have approved; jobs asking for 2 or more years of experience are left out; agencies hiring for hidden clients, crypto and data-labelling jobs are left out
- Freshness: the list is refreshed every 6 hours and each job is removed after 14 days or when it closes
- Cost: free for job seekers and free for employers to post a job; no signup
- Founder: Sohil Baitha, Delhi, India
